name: Forgive
overview: The Scriptures emphasize that forgiveness is both a divine command and a reflection of God's own mercy toward us. Believers are called to forgive others consistently and generously, as shown in Jesus' teaching that forgiving others is essential for receiving God's forgiveness (Matthew 6:14, Mark 11:25). Forgiveness involves not only overlooking offenses but also restoring relationships when repentance occurs (Luke 17:3). This Christ-centered call to forgive underscores the believer's dependence on God's grace and the necessity of extending that grace to others.
